Render the CTAS site-level report from a CTAS summary

Report_CTAS.Rd

One-call wrapper that runs the chart-preparation pipeline (Prune_Metrics() -> MakeCharts()) and hands the result to gsm.kri::Report_KRI() together with the vendored inst/report/Report_CTAS.Rmd template. The chart builder is the internal MakeCharts() / Visualize_CTAS() pair (not gsm.kri::MakeCharts()) so Widget_BarChart only offers "Score" – the CTAS dfResults contract has no Numerator/Denominator/Metric columns.

Usage

Report_CTAS(
  lReporting,
  strOutputDir = getwd(),
  strOutputFile = NULL,
  dfBounds = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

lReporting

Named list with summary, metrics, groups frames – the shape produced by Summarize_CTAS().

strOutputDir

Output directory for the rendered html.

strOutputFile

Output file name; defaults to Report_KRI's auto-generated name.

dfBounds

Optional bounds frame forwarded to the internal MakeCharts().

...

Further arguments forwarded to gsm.kri::Report_KRI().

Value

character(1) File path of the rendered html report, invisibly.

Details

strOutputDir is normalized to an absolute path so rmarkdown::render() doesn't resolve it against the template's directory. strInputPath is resolved via system.file() inside the gsm.ctas namespace so pkgload's inst/ shim picks it up under devtools::load_all().
